lines.en: Light armor is easy, so my steps come fast.

lines.zh: 短剑挂在腰侧，晃来晃去。
lines.en: A short blade swings at my hip.
I follow the banner and keep in file.

lines.zh: 沙土路被一群人踩得发白。
lines.en: Our boots turn the dirt road pale.
At each post I check the arrow slits.
My boot is worn through. I say nothing.
Around the tents to the next post.

lines.zh: 肩上缺了块铁，风直往里钻。
lines.en: A plate is missing; wind cuts in.

lines.zh: 我走在最外侧，替人挡风。
lines.en: I take the outer file to block the wind.

lines.zh: 步子轻，是不想惊动哨兵。
lines.en: Light steps, so I do not wake the sentries.
I am third in the line.
The road is slick; I nearly fall.
The short blade feels like dead weight now.
I must reach my post before the change.
Back against a post, chewing hardtack.
Worn long enough, light armor grows loose.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我的矛架上。
lines.en: A bird lands on my weapon rack.

lines.zh: 营地里最闲的就是我这班。
lines.en: My watch is the quietest in camp.
I want to drill, but fear the mockery.
I count the patches on the tents.
My fingers tap a beat on the scabbard.
Today's post faces the latrine pit.
Brim low against the sun.

lines.zh: 听见厨房响动就精神了。
lines.en: Every clatter from the kitchen wakes me up.
This armor was handed down from someone else.
To be a knight, I first stand enough watches.
The wind makes the banner snap.
Oat cake crumbs still in my teeth.
Hey. Who are you looking for?
Not too close. I am on duty.
Are you the new replacement?

lines.zh: 轻甲不顶事，可我也不怕你。
lines.en: Light armor is weak, but I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 看你走路的样子，不像士兵。
lines.en: You do not walk like a soldier.
Stop there, and say which side you serve.

lines.zh: 我喊一声，营里就全醒了。
lines.en: One shout from me wakes the whole camp.
Put that thing away.
I do not know you. Do not pretend.
You need an escort to enter camp.

lines.zh: 你今天运气好，我心情不错。
lines.en: Lucky you. I am in a good mood.
My blade is short, but it reaches fast.

lines.zh: 靴子上的土，是刚巡逻回来。
lines.en: That dirt means I just came off patrol.
Keep staring and I take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 营门在后头，问路去那边。
lines.en: The gate is behind me. Ask there.

lines.zh: 我不过是个小兵，别为难我。
lines.en: I am only a footman. Do not make this hard.
Ow. That one landed hard.

lines.zh: 甲片挡了一半，剩下一半疼。
lines.en: The plate took half; the rest still hurts.
I stagger, then find my feet.
Light armor pays for it. I know.
Blood drips from my sleeve.
Nothing much. I can still hold the blade.
I bit my own tongue.
I hold it in; crying out invites mockery.
This one goes in the ledger.
Two steps back, then I step in again.
Is that food? It smells decent.
Give me new boots and I can run all day.
A new blade? Let me feel it.
My pay is three days late.

lines.zh: 有肉的话，我什么都好说。
lines.en: Meat, and I am easy to deal with.
Do not wave food past my post.
My edge is already rolled over.
My stomach growls at cooked food.
This patched armor needs replacing.
One sip of wine. Just one.
Hey, watch where you step.
This armor is thin; that actually hurt.
You knocked me off my post.
Do not push, there are more behind me.
Steady, we are both short.
Bump me, fine. Bump the banner, no.
Shoulder to shoulder, and you are stronger.
Step back, I have to call the roll.
No shoving in ranks. Remember it.
A footman is in no position for that.
I do not even have a bunk of my own.
Ask me again after I am promoted.
The ranks allow no families.
I have not even replaced my blade.
Who would want this hand-me-down armor?
My oath went to Red first.
I stand night watch. No time.
If you eat army rations, you understand.
That needs a report. Not to me.
Whose copper coin is this?
Half an oat cake found is half mine.
Everything in camp gets logged.
I bend and a plate clicks.
Where did this arrowhead come from? Mine now.
First I check for an owner's mark.
Found means returned. That is the rule.
Just a rock. I drop it again.
My pocket has a hole. Bad luck.
Something moved. I have eyes on it.
Alarm! Someone at the gate.
Short blade out. Do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我不冲最前，可我也不躲。
lines.en: I am not first in, but I do not hide.
Seen it, by the camp wall.
The banner swings, and the line follows.
I shout first, then close in.
This fight, I hold the corner.
You will not escape. Do not bother.
My palm sweats; my grip tightens.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个影子，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at that shadow without blinking.
Three paces away is just right.
Any movement and I call the squad.
Do not turn. I am behind you.
I inch forward, one step at a time.
Short blade up at my chest.
Wait for help, or go now?
The banner is at the edge of my sight.
Even my breathing has gone quiet.
I have drilled for standoffs like this.
A flat swing comes up fast.
Short weapons must fight close.
A thrust at the flank.
My blade is light, but quick.
I land one and pull back.
Strength loses; I must circle.
Armor rings, steel rings.
I grit my teeth and push forward.
An old soldier taught me that.
Sword back, a breath, then again.
Red footman reporting.
I came with my pack on my back.
The camp was short-handed. I fill the gap.

lines.zh: 短剑还在鞘里，先看队列。
lines.en: Blade still sheathed; first I find the line.

lines.zh: 帽子上还沾着路上的灰。
lines.en: Road dust still on my cap.
From today, this post is mine.
Form up, no pushing. I am taking names.
Assign me work. I do not pick.
The captain sent me.

lines.zh: 这身甲虽然是旧的，还合身。
lines.en: Old armor, but it fits.
My sleeve is on fire. Swat it!
I slid off the watch ladder.
Water to my chin, and I swallowed some.
Clods of earth slap my back.
An arrow grazed past my ear.
What is this light? I cannot block it.
Rations have not come down yet.
My hair stands up; my body goes numb.
The whole camp goes black.
